purpose: One real small same-graph H3 three-step trajectory -> frozen VAE -> synthetic RGB loss backward. Engineering connectivity, forward parity, restoration and memory only.

execution.fresh_admission_required: Single explicitly assigned physical card; logical npu:0 mapping; no foreign PID; >=60000 MB free; shared card-specific lock; 15-second second resource check; new immutable runtime/run and owned process group.
execution.failure_policy: Stop on first failed gate. Preserve observations and finally restoration/frozen/runtime/memory evidence before terminal verdict. No retry, OOM fallback, geometry reduction, scale/tolerance search or automatic next phase.
pre_implementation_requirements: Review the new separate CLI and CPU tests for joint math-context transitions, same-graph RGB-only backward, counters and failure restoration.

Freeze complete local snapshot plus union of actual H3 b and VAE j Comfy/kitchen dependencies, all asset hashes and actual imported-module identities. This source-reading contract is not a complete executable pin set.
Read-only deterministic flags recorded; preserve established JIT=false/HF32=false runtime. Do not change deterministic level or math dispatch as an undeclared factor.

H3_b.scope: Completed 5-frame/128-square latent-only synthetic objective. It did not decode VAE or backpropagate RGB.

VAE_j.scope: Fixed synthetic latent local descent; 559 named-parameter fingerprints, not all buffers. Remote CPU auditor verified saved arrays; local small archive verified hashes/scalars, not absent RGB outputs.

verified_prior_evidence.inference_limit: Separate successful H3 and VAE probes do not establish joint same-graph memory or gradients. Do not add their peaks to claim a measured joint peak.

fixed_model_and_inputs.recipe: refiner-turbo-comfy; verified pretrained base/refiner/Turbo/context and existing FP16 VAE
fixed_model_and_inputs.constructor: One verified H3 with native sigmas, adaptation_path=None, lora_path=None. Reuse its own bound VAE; do not create a different decoder or use load_vae_only to substitute asset identity.
fixed_model_and_inputs.geometry: Native dimensions; no padding, crop, resize, tiling-policy change or frame subsampling.
fixed_model_and_inputs.input_recipe: CPU torch.Generator(seed=101), float32 randn guide first then distinct raw warm-start second, exactly as completed H3 b. Save actual arrays and SHA. Neither is claimed to be a VAE encoding of an observed image.
fixed_model_and_inputs.noise: Actual comfy.sample.prepare_noise NestedTensor, shared CPU generator drawing video then audio. Reference and candidate must share exact initial/noise/guide/context bytes.
fixed_model_and_inputs.sampler: Euler zero-churn; native official joint video/audio conditioning and x0/latent-in/out transforms; CFG1; mode=base; refs=[]; no innerDC/mask/soft anchor.

adaptation.arithmetic: Independent FP32 adapter branch on BF16 base. No merge, optimizer, STE or token-refiner adapter.

residency_and_math.same_device: Static fully resident frozen DiT and frozen VAE on the same admitted NPU. VAE disable_offload=true; device=offload_device=h3.dev; all parameters/buffers resident; both eval mode. No low-VRAM/dynamic patcher or hidden offload during retained graph.
residency_and_math.reference_lifecycle: Run official H3.sample without new adapter, then restore/revalidate full resident state and byte identity before reference decode/injection as necessary. Rebuild parameter object/version snapshot only after a verified restore; byte changes fail.
residency_and_math.DiT_context: Existing native_training_math for reference sampling and candidate trajectory. Keep ResidentH3Trajectory alive through backward. Each DiT recomputation must observe DiT math; snapshot transformer_options per block invocation.
residency_and_math.VAE_reference_context: Existing h3.decode under native_training_math and torch.no_grad, casting its exact final video latent to the bound VAE dtype float16.
residency_and_math.VAE_candidate_context: ResidentH3Trajectory.decode on the retained final video; differentiable FP32->FP16 cast and direct vae.decode. Use checkpoint_decoder=True with native ascend functional RoPE per forward/per recomputation context_fn, not the decoder-only outer scope across joint backward.
residency_and_math.context_isolation: The temporary ascend_native decoder context must restore DiT math immediately after decode and after every decoder recompute. Do not let a global VAE context span DiT backward. Record expected function identities/flags at phase and block/recompute boundaries; instance wrappers and patcher attributes restored on all paths.

checkpoint.count_boundary: For this 5-frame latent-T2/native128 geometry, expect 36 VAE calls, not the full22x480x832 108. Count actual block entries independently; checkpoint recomputation is extra work, not another explicit denoiser NFE. No nested decoder-only checkpoint helper on already wrapped blocks.

requirements: Exact snapshot/assets and actual import binding; declared geometry/input arrays/noise hashes.
Frozen base and VAE parameter bytes/shape/dtype plus versions and requires_grad/grad state; separately inventory/hash registered buffers with explicit scope, not untracked Python caches.
Snapshot global math identities/flags, block forward attribute presence/identity, patcher state, device residency and counters.

phases.operation: Official H3.sample on shared raw warm start/guide/noise; official h3.decode on its final video, FP16 input. Save final video+audio, actual decoder cast bytes and float32 returned RGB.
phases.RGB_semantics: as_returned_internal_clipped native VAE RGB, no additional clipping/quantization. Do not label as true pre-internal-clamp raw RGB.

phases.operation: Restore and verify resident base, inject rank8 zero-B. In one retained trajectory session sample once, then decode that exact graph-bearing video. Never detach/recreate latent, call H3.sample for candidate, or use a separate sigma loss.

parity_before_backward.H3: Final float32 video AND audio must torch.equal reference with identical inputs, all finite and same shape. Report max_abs/relative L2 and actual output hashes; nonzero difference fails.
parity_before_backward.decoder_input: Candidate and reference FP16 decoder-input bytes exactly identical; save both.
parity_before_backward.RGB: Float32 returned RGB shape[5,128,128,3], finite; torch.allclose atol=0.0002, rtol=0.0001 against reference. Record torch.equal, max_abs, relativeL2 and actual pixel SHA. Existing VAE tolerance is unchanged; bitexact is measured, not a new requirement.
parity_before_backward.graph: Candidate video and RGB retain grad_fn/requires_grad. retain_grad on final video to audit the RGB path. No latent/audio auxiliary loss.

phases.target: CPU float32 torch.linspace(0.2,0.8,128)[None,None,:,None], broadcast to[5,128,128,3]. Save recipe/array SHA. Fixed synthetic probe pattern, no dataset/GT and never a model input.
phases.loss: mean((candidate_RGB.float().cpu() - target)**2), CPU float32. Preserve autograd across device copy; report unscaled loss and backward exactly once on loss*1024.
gradient_gates: Retained final-video raw gradient exists, finite and nonzero; save raw and FP32 divided-by1024 arrays.
Exactly400 declared adapter gradient tensors present and finite; report/save raw and FP32 unscaled gradient evidence by canonical module name.

Aggregate B gradient L2>0 and at least one nonzero B tensor; record all200 B tensor outcomes. Do not require nonzero A at zero B, or impose a new norm lower bound or require every B nonzero for this new RGB-only objective.
Base/VAE gradients remain None, requires_grad remains false, parameter bytes and versions unchanged; adapter values/versions unchanged because there is no optimizer.
Observed DiT/VAE per-block forward and recompute counts match the fixed budgets; no extra whole-model forward during backward.
phases.audio_boundary: Audio is carried jointly for all three steps and forward parity is required. No direct audio loss or claim of final-audio RGB gradient is required.

requirements: Persist outputs, gradient arrays/hashes, counters, memory phase and failure observations before judging complete.

Restore checkpoint wrappers, temporary math functions/flags, current_patcher/latent_shapes and observers; compare pre/post attributes and recorded runtime. Check stale guard directly without an additional autograd backward.
Re-fingerprint frozen parameters and separately declared buffers, even after a failure when the process remains viable. Write missing evidence explicitly on OOM/timeout.
complete=true requires all earlier numerical, budget, residency, freeze and restoration gates. Missing evidence or changed bytes fails acceptance.

arrays: packed initial/noise or fully reproducible actual-byte records
evidence_requirements.manifest: Actual file SHA and array-byte SHA, shape/dtype/role for each; atomic phase report and final complete/failure state; no overwrite.
evidence_requirements.resource: Phase synchronized allocated/reserved peaks, total peak, current/max RSS, elapsed time, NPU mapping, actual counters. This run measures small joint memory only.
evidence_requirements.new_thresholds: None for numerical equality or gradient magnitude; reuse existing H3 strict, VAE allclose and finite/nonzero gates. No gradient SHA repeatability gate is claimed.

ordered_separate_followups_not_authorize.scope: New reviewed bounded small-geometry experiment must declare its optimizer/update magnitude beforehand, show actual B changes and base/VAE unchanged, then strict serialized adapter bytes and unmerged same-input forward parity. This zero-adapter probe does not accept it.

Compare the same nonzero independent FP32 adapter against existing FP32 W+BA then once-cast BF16 inference merge. Record latent/RGB max_abs, relativeL2, clipping and fixed objective changes separately. No claim of bitexact equivalence, no STE; acceptance policy must be declared in that separate experiment before execution.
New fixed22x480x832 same-graph contract/admission after small joint and nonzero deployment gates. No assumption from separate peaks; no automatic OOM geometry fallback.
